entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
O Beloved, did you not see how your Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant?
Did He not put their trick into devastation?
And sent swarms of birds over them.
Striking them with stones of baked clay.
So, He made them like the leftover consumed leaves of harvest (i.e. husk).
